title: SAT Math 5 — Equivalent Expressions Quiz
question: Five SAT-style questions on equivalent expressions, with full working.
intro: Five questions on equivalent expressions. **Show your working before you choose or type an answer.**

questions.title: Exponent rules
questions.prompt:
For \(x > 0\), which expression is equivalent to

\[\frac{(2x^3)^2 \cdot x^{-1}}{8x^2}\,?\]

questions.title: Subtract two fractions
questions.prompt:
For \(x \ne 1\) and \(x \ne -1\), which is equivalent to

\[\frac{2}{x - 1} - \frac{1}{x + 1}\,?\]
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} \frac{2(x + 1) - (x - 1)}{(x - 1)(x + 1)} &= \frac{2x + 2 - x + 1}{x^2 - 1} \\ &= \frac{x + 3}{x^2 - 1} \end{aligned}\]

\(x + 1\) on top comes from \(-(x - 1) = -x - 1\): the minus must reach the \(-1\) too.

questions.title: Fractional exponents
questions.solution_title: Write the roots as powers, then add
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} \sqrt[3]{x^2} &= x^{2/3} \\ \sqrt{x} &= x^{1/2} \\ x^{2/3} \cdot x^{1/2} &= x^{2/3 + 1/2} \\ &= x^{7/6} \end{aligned}\]

\(x^{1/3}\) multiplies the exponents instead of adding them.

questions.title: Difference of squares
questions.prompt:
\[\begin{aligned} x - y &= 4 \\ x + y &= 9 \end{aligned}\]

What is the value of \(x^2 - y^2\)?
questions.solution_title: No need to find x and y

questions.title: Complete the square
questions.solution:
\[\begin{aligned} (x + 5)^2 &= x^2 + 10x + 25 \\ x^2 + 10x + 31 &= (x + 5)^2 + 6 \end{aligned}\]

\((x + 5)^2 + 31\) would give a constant of 56.

takeaway: Expand or factor carefully, use the exponent rules, and when two polynomials are equal for all x, match their coefficients.
